name: 98584 · Shelton, WA
findings: ZIP 98584 (Shelton) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98584 (Shelton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98584 (Shelton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
